correctness.rationale: Each pairwise coordinate difference is multiplied by r-eta times the product of all other probabilities at an active step, hence contracts strictly. The scalar gain G(x) has one strict maximum m_n and a product of k gains yields the sharp necessary reinforcement threshold. Equality requires every pre-contact probability to be x_* and every gap to equal a. The symmetric equal-gap map has exactly zero, one or two positive roots by unimodality, and contraction plus monotonicity on the invariant after-silence cube proves global convergence. Nonuniform strict subidentity follows from compactness and extends above threshold by continuity; the scalar subidentity plus contracting asymmetry proves global extinction. Exact rational group-size and three-node witnesses, plus independently recomputed numerical updates, were checked from the current standalone program.

originality.rationale: The closest original higher-order social-contagion models establish autonomous bistability and simulate temporal random simplicial networks, but the inspected primary text does not derive the strict optimality of uniform integer gap allocation at fixed contact count and total inactivity. The theorem compares nonlinear compositions and handles arbitrary asymmetric individual-probability initial states via exact difference contraction. Existing autonomous-flow and scalar-map statements do not imply comparison of differently ordered pulse compositions. Searches identified no covering exact result, subject to publication-priority uncertainty.
residual_risks: The search of publication literature and semantically ranked research records was nonexhaustive; publication priority is not independently certified.

value.rationale: A fixed count of social reinforcement encounters and fixed total idle duration is a natural intervention budget. The proof gives a sharp optimal activation arrangement for every homogeneous group size and budget multiple, not merely an example or a reparameterized autonomous equilibrium. It proves strict persistence loss from clustering identical events at onset, an all-initial-state extinction conclusion, and a natural group-size cutoff. It also identifies important limits of the independent-probability closure.
